[b]Public release of trade documents[/b]
The Hydronian federal government has formally released all series of trade documents to the general public, following a mid-war economic check as the stalemate remains on the eastern frontlines.

[b][u]IMPORTS[/u][/b]
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation] : gold
[nation]-Chimor[/nation] : silver
[nation]Demste[/nation] : farming equipment
[nation]Alkiragunya[/nation] : Copper, diamonds, jewellery
[nation]Abadi-JR[/nation] : limestone
[nation]Dhornaper[/nation] : aluminium 
[nation]Karcovshkie[/nation] : Uranium, gold, Iron
[nation]Tan Srpka[/nation] : Copper
[nation]Nordiheim[/nation] : Oil
[nation]BR Bob[/nation] : Uranium
[nation]Averne[/nation] : Copper, Gold, Coal, Oil, Lithium

[b][u]EXPORTS[/u][/b]
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation] : oil
[nation]-Chimor[/nation] : Lithium
[nation]Demste[/nation] : Aluminium
[nation]Alkiragunya[/nation] : Aluminium, Iron
[nation]Abadi-JR[/nation] : Iron
[nation]Dhornaper[/nation] : uranium, food produce
[nation]Karcovshkie[/nation] : Oil, Aluminium, Lithium
[nation]Tan srpka[/nation] : Aluminium, Lithium
[nation]Nordiheim[/nation] : Lithium
[nation]BR Bob[/nation] : Lithium
[nation]Averne[/nation] : Oil, Iron, Aluminium, Lithium, Gas, Uranium

All nations mentioned above are required to ratify these agreements in accordance with international law (just quote this saying I agree or something).
